description: This file defines the 'Source' interface within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.connectivity package, representing a data structure that encapsulates the configuration and properties of a message source in the Ditto connectivity model. It includes method signatures for retrieving addresses, consumer count, authorization, QoS, enforcement, acknowledgements, header mappings, payload mappings, reply targets, acknowledgement labels, and JSON serialization details.

classes.name: Source
classes.description: An interface representing a message source configuration for external connectivity within the Ditto model.

methods.name: getAddresses
methods.description: Returns the set of addresses associated with this source.

methods.name: getConsumerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of consumers (connections) to be opened to the remote server.

methods.name: getAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Retrieves the authorization context for the source, overriding the connection context if set.

methods.name: getIndex
methods.description: Returns an index to distinguish between sources.

methods.name: getQos
methods.description: Returns an optional QoS value applicable for certain connection types.

methods.name: getEnforcement
methods.description: Retrieves enforcement options for the source.

methods.name: getAcknowledgementRequests
methods.description: Returns acknowledgement requests with optional filters for messages consumed from this source.

methods.name: getHeaderMapping
methods.description: Returns optional header mapping configurations for inbound message headers.

methods.name: getPayloadMapping
methods.description: Returns payload mappings to be applied to received messages.

methods.name: getReplyTarget
methods.description: Returns the target for handling Ditto command responses.

methods.name: isReplyTargetEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether reply-target functionality is enabled.

methods.name: getDeclaredAcknowledgementLabels
methods.description: Returns the set of acknowledged labels this source can send.

calls: toJson(final JsonSchemaVersion schemaVersion, final JsonFieldSelector fieldSelector)
